title: The bill changes only after the click, and only the stored call runs
subtitle: Example: the person says "I paid the electricity bill by card". The values are made up; the design is the usual one.

steps.sub: mark_paid b17 · v3 · card · id c2

steps.label:
on the confirm list:
do not run

right user · not expired
unused: all pass

outcome.title: Paid: City Power AG, CHF 84.20, by card
lines: Only the stored call ran, once. On Cancel nothing runs, and the model gets a declined result under c2.

captions.title: Let the harmless read run at once
captions.text: The model asks for `find_bills`. Reading changes nothing, so it runs at once. The bill goes back with its version: b17, CHF 84.20, version 3.

captions.title: Hold the risky write instead of running it
captions.text: The model asks for `mark_paid` with b17, version 3 and card, under call id c2. `mark_paid` is on the confirm list, a constant in code, so it does not run.

captions.title: Check the change can happen before asking anyone
captions.text: Code checks that the bill exists, is at version 3 and is unpaid. A call that would fail goes back to the model at once, with no card.

captions.title: Code draws the card from the stored bill
captions.text: Payee and amount come from the stored bill: City Power AG, CHF 84.20. The proposal is saved with an expiry and the chat request ends. Billpod seals it in a token instead, valid 10 minutes.

captions.title: The click sends only the row id and the decision
captions.text: The server runs only what it stored, for the user it was made for, once. Billpod: a changed token gets 400, an expired one 410, a second answer 409.

captions.title: Run exactly the stored call, checking the version again
captions.text: The write runs `WHERE version = 3`: 1 row updated. If the bill had changed, 0 rows, and that refusal goes to the model. Either way, the card is used up.

captions.title: Give the model its answer under its own call id
captions.text: The click's request loads the stored chat, adds the result under c2 and asks the model again. It replies "Done: marked paid." On Cancel, the model gets a declined result under c2.
